Just read B2B Brand Positioning: How to Stop Looking Like Everyone Else?. Your "Are You Forgettable" test runs five checks, from "The logo swap" to "The strip test", and the page says only about 5% of buyers are in market at any moment.

I run a motion studio. Happy to swap founder quotes: one from me for your "Are You Forgettable" section, and one from your side for ours.

In return, a credit link back to motiontheagency.com with my quote, and one to yours with your quote on ours, or we'll pay for placement instead.

Would you be open to exploring this?

Cheers,
Sam
